equip.text: Chapter 55, Sec. 55.30 (Revocable Encroachment Permit): 'The city may issue a revocable encroachment permit that allows removable items to encroach into a 20-foot wide easement. The removable structure shall meet the required zoning setbacks.' The table 'Permitted Easement Encroachments (Applies to 20-Foot Wide Easement Only)' gives, in feet of distance into the easement: Generator Pad - residential property 10, commercial property not permitted; Accessory Pad (Includes Dumpster) - residential not permitted, commercial 10; Moveable (skid mounted) Accessory Building 10 residential and 10 commercial; Solar Energy System 10 residential; Screen Enclosure 10 residential; Flag Pole 10 residential; Fence 20 both; Wall 0 to 20 both. Note the express condition that the encroaching structure must still meet the zoning setbacks - the easement permit relieves the easement, not the setback.

equip.cite: Accessory uses and structures generally
equip.text: Sec. 158.217(A): 'Accessory structures and uses are permitted in any zoning district in connection with any principal lawfully existing permitted use within that district, provided that all accessory structures or uses are in full compliance with all setback, height, building coverage, and other requirements of the zoning district, and all other requirements of this section. In no case shall accessory uses, either separately or in combination, exceed more than twenty (20%) percent of the total floor area of the principal building or ground area of any lot, whichever is more restrictive...'

equip.cite: Accessory structure placement in single-family districts
equip.text: Sec. 158.217(C)(1): 'Accessory uses or structures shall not be located in that area extending from the front corners of the principal structure to the front property line, unless otherwise specifically provided. Accessory uses or structures shall be located a minimum of ten (10) feet from the rear property line. The minimum setback from side property lines shall be those set forth in the applicable zoning district.' This is the provision a permanent generator pad falls under in RE and RS-1 through RS-3 - the code does not name generators separately.

equip.cite: Solar and other ground-mounted energy devices
equip.text: Sec. 158.217(C)(2)j: 'Solar energy systems, windmills, and other energy devices based on renewable resources. Solar ground and pole mounted energy systems may be located no closer than six (6) feet to any side lot line and ten feet to any rear lot line.'

equip.cite: Yard encroachments
equip.text: Sec. 158.214: 'Every part of a required yard shall be open and unobstructed from the ground to the sky except as hereinafter provided... (A) Sills or belt courses may project not over twelve (12) inches into a required yard; (B) Cornices, eaves, gutters, movable awnings or outside utilities may project not over three (3) feet into a required yard; (C) Chimneys, fireplaces, or pilasters may project not over two (2) feet into a required yard; (D) Hoods, canopies, or marquees may project not over three (3) feet into a required yard, but shall not extend closer than one (1) foot to any lot line; (E) Parking may be located in the required building setback line...; (F) Flag poles may be located no closer than ten (10) feet to the property lines.' The phrase 'outside utilities' in (B) is the only mechanical-equipment encroachment the section allows, and it is capped at three feet.

equip.cite: Mechanical equipment screening
equip.text: The same sentence appears in the landscaping subsection of GU (Sec. 158.060), I (Sec. 158.110), CN (Sec. 158.120), P (Sec. 158.122), CG (Sec. 158.124), CH (Sec. 158.125), CS (Sec. 158.126), WI (Sec. 158.135), IN (Sec. 158.136) and U (Sec. 158.137): 'All mechanical equipment shall be screened from property zoned residential. This screening shall be designed as both a visual barrier and a noise barrier.' In GU it is preceded by: 'A six-foot high completely opaque masonry wall or wooden fence shall be provided along the entire length of any side or rear property line abutting property zoned residential.'

equip.cite: Exclusion from height limits; essential services
equip.text: Sec. 158.215(A): 'Utility penthouses, scenery lofts, towers, cupolas, steeples, domes, flag poles, airplane beacons, broadcasting towers, antennas, chimneys, stacks, tanks, roof mounted solar energy systems, non-roof installed solar energy devices integrated into the architecture of the building, and roof structures used only for ornamental or mechanical purposes may exceed the permissible height limit in any district by not more than twenty-five (25) percent... In addition, essential services shall be exempted from the height limit provisions of this chapter.'

equip.cite: Site plan review exemption for generators
equip.text: Sec. 158.237(F): 'The following development shall be exempt from the site plan revision process specified in subsections 158.237(C) and (D) of this chapter PROVIDED THAT ALL APPLICABLE SETBACKS ARE MET and the changes are incorporated into a future major or minor revision of the site plan if applicable:... (3) Construction associated with the installation of emergency electric power generators or solar facilities on previously approved developments. (4) The construction of uninhabitable accessory less than 300 square feet in size (i.e., dumpster enclosures, sheds, awnings, etc.) on previously approved developments.' This is a process exemption conditioned on the setbacks still being met, not a setback relief.

equip.cite: Setback from a natural body of water
equip.text: Sec. 158.202: 'No buildings or structures within any single-family residential zoning district shall be erected closer than fifty (50) feet to the mean high water line of any natural and public body of water; no building or structure within a zoning district other than a single-family district shall be erected closer than seventy-five (75) feet to the mean high water line; except that the restriction shall not apply in the case of a boat dock, board walks, marina, or marina-associated structures.' The section then lists the specific platted lots it applies to.

GU.note: General Use, Sec. 158.060. Recorded numbers are the single-family dwelling row: minimum parcel 10 acres (435,600 sf) and a minimum width of 330 ft; maximum building coverage 10 per cent; front 50, side 30 each side, rear 50. All other permitted or special exception uses: minimum parcel 20,000 sf and lot width 100 ft; maximum building coverage 30 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent.

RE.note: Estate Residential, Sec. 158.071. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 100 ft. Yard figures are stated 'unless otherwise provided by this chapter'; corner lots take Sec. 158.203 instead (see gaps). Minimum living area 1,700 sf with 2,200 sf of ground area for a one-story house, or 1,700 sf living area with 1,500 sf ground area for a two-story house.

RS-1.note: Single-Family Residential, Sec. 158.072. Single-family dwelling: 15,000 sf and a minimum width of 75 ft; all other permitted or special exception uses: 20,000 sf and a width of 100 ft. No maximum building coverage is printed for RS-1. Minimum living area 1,700 sf with 2,200 sf ground area (one-story) or 1,700 sf with 1,500 sf ground area (two-story). Corner lots take Sec. 158.203 side-street setbacks.

RS-2.note: Single-Family Residential, Sec. 158.073. Single-family dwelling: 10,000 sf and a minimum width of 60 ft; all other permitted or special exception uses: 20,000 sf and a width of 100 ft. No maximum building coverage is printed. Minimum living area 1,200 sf with 1,400 sf ground area (one-story) or 1,400 sf with 1,300 sf ground area (two-story). Corner lots take Sec. 158.203.

RS-3.note: Single-Family Residential, Sec. 158.076. Single-family dwelling: 7,500 sf and a minimum width of 60 ft; all other permitted or special exception uses: 20,000 sf and a width of 100 ft. No maximum building coverage is printed. Minimum living area 1,200 sf with 1,400 sf ground area (one-story) or 1,400 sf with 1,300 sf ground area (two-story). Corner lots take Sec. 158.203.

RM-5.note: Multiple-Family Residential, Sec. 158.077. Recorded lot figures are the multiple-family dwelling row (20,000 sf, width 100 ft, maximum gross project density 5 dwelling units per acre). Other rows: single-family dwelling 7,500 sf and width 60 ft; single-family cluster 4,000 sf per dwelling unit and width 40 ft; townhouse per Sec. 158.218 - all at a maximum gross project density of 5 du/ac.

RM-8.note: Multiple-Family Residential, Sec. 158.078. Recorded lot figures are the multiple-family dwelling row (20,000 sf, width 100 ft, maximum gross project density 8 dwelling units per acre). Other rows: single-family 7,500 sf and width 60 ft at 5 du/ac; single-family cluster 4,000 sf per unit and width 40 ft at 8 du/ac; townhouse per Sec. 158.218 at 8 du/ac; all other uses 20,000 sf and width 100 ft.

RM-11.note: Multiple-Family Residential, Sec. 158.079. Recorded lot figures are the multiple-family dwelling row (20,000 sf, width 150 ft, maximum gross project density 11 dwelling units per acre). Other rows: single-family 7,500 sf and width 60 ft at 5 du/ac; single-family cluster 4,000 sf per unit and width 40 ft at 11 du/ac; townhouse per Sec. 158.218 at 11 du/ac.

RM-15.note: Multiple-Family Residential, Sec. 158.080. Recorded lot figures are the multiple-family dwelling row (30,000 sf, width 150 ft, maximum gross project density 15 dwelling units per acre). Other rows: single-family 7,500 sf and width 60 ft at 5 du/ac; single-family cluster 3,500 sf and width 40 ft at 15 du/ac; townhouse per Sec. 158.218 at 15 du/ac.

RMH.note: Mobile Home Residential, Sec. 158.081. Recorded minimums are the mobile home park row: 10 acres (435,600 sf) with a minimum frontage of 175 ft upon a public street or highway, maximum gross project density 5 dwelling units per acre. All other permitted uses: 20,000 sf and width 100 ft. Coverage 35 per cent with impervious surface not exceeding 50 per cent. Minimum distance of 15 ft between buildings or mobile homes.

OSR.frontNote: Sec. 158.100(I): 'All yard requirements shall be established for each specific use as part of the site plan review process, provided that the minimum building setback line shall be twenty-five (25) feet abutting property zoned residential.'
OSR.sideNote: Same as front - set at site plan review, with a 25 ft minimum abutting property zoned residential.
OSR.rearNote: Same as front - set at site plan review, with a 25 ft minimum abutting property zoned residential.
OSR.note: Open Space Recreational. Minimum lot: 'Site of adequate size and proportions to accommodate the intended use, but not less than twenty thousand (20,000) square feet and having a minimum width of one hundred (100) feet.' Maximum building coverage 35 per cent provided the combined area coverage of all impervious surfaces does not exceed 50 per cent.

OSC.note: Open Space Conservation, Sec. 158.101. No dimensional envelope is printed: 'Minimum Lot Requirements. No minimum requirements.' 'Maximum Building Coverage. Building coverage shall be established for each specific use as part of the site plan review process.' 'Maximum Building Height.

I.note: Institutional, Sec. 158.110. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 100 ft. Coverage 30 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Height 35 ft, except one story in the ROI conversion area lying between Airoso Boulevard and U.S. #1, and the maximum may be increased to 65 ft for publicly owned or operated buildings or uses.

CN.note: Neighborhood Convenience Commercial, Sec. 158.120. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 100 ft; the MAXIMUM lot size shall not exceed 4 acres. Coverage 40 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Side yard 10 ft, but 25 ft adjacent to any residential future land use category or to a public right-of-way.

P.note: Professional, Sec. 158.122. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 100 ft. Coverage 40 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Height 35 ft, except one story in the ROI conversion area lying between Airoso Boulevard and U.S. #1; see Sec. 158.174(E) for height variations allowed through PUD zoning.

CG.note: General Commercial, Sec. 158.124. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 100 ft. Coverage 40 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Height 35 ft; see Sec. 158.174(E) for height variations allowed through PUD zoning. Side setback 10 ft, but 25 ft when the yard adjoins a residential future land use category or a public right-of-way.

CH.note: Highway Commercial, Sec. 158.125. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 100 ft. Coverage 30 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Height 50 ft. Side setback 10 ft, but 25 ft when the yard adjoins a residential future land use category or a public right-of-way. Rear setback 10 ft, but 25 ft when it abuts a residential future land use category or a public right-of-way.

CS.note: Service Commercial, Sec. 158.126. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 100 ft. Coverage 40 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Side setback 10 ft, but 25 ft when it adjoins a residential future land use category or a public right-of-way. Rear setback 10 ft, but 25 ft when it abuts a residential future land use category or public right-of-way.

WI.note: Warehouse Industrial, Sec. 158.135. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 100 ft. Coverage 50 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Height 35 ft, except for transmission and broadcast towers. Side setback 10 ft, but 25 ft maintained adjacent to any residential future land use category or to a public street right-of-way.

IN.note: Industrial, Sec. 158.136. Minimum lot 20,000 sf and minimum width 160 ft. Coverage 50 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Height 35 ft, except for transmission and broadcast towers. Side setback 10 ft, but 25 ft maintained adjacent to any residential future land use category or to a public right-of-way.

U.note: Utility, Sec. 158.137. Minimum lot 10,000 sf and minimum width 80 ft; billboards, transmission towers, pumping and relay facilities may be located on lots smaller than 10,000 sf. Coverage 30 per cent with combined impervious surface not exceeding 80 per cent. Height 50 ft, except for transmission and broadcast towers.

LMD.note: Limited Mixed Use, Sec. 158.155. Minimum lot: 'As set forth in the Comprehensive Plan, and pursuant to conceptual plan approval. In no case shall the minimum lot be less than twenty thousand (20,000) square feet.' Maximum gross project density 11 units per acre. No minimum lot width is printed. Coverage 40 per cent with maximum impervious surface area not exceeding 80 per cent.

PUD.frontNote: Sec. 158.170 et seq.: setbacks in a Planned Unit Development are fixed by the approved conceptual plan and PUD ordinance, not by a printed district envelope.
PUD.sideNote: Set by the approved PUD conceptual plan and ordinance.
PUD.rearNote: Set by the approved PUD conceptual plan and ordinance.
PUD.heightNote: Sec. 158.174(E): 'The maximum height of all residential structures not within a PUD, shall be thirty-five (35) feet. Within a PUD, greater than five (5) acres, the maximum height permitted is seventy-five (75) feet.
PUD.note: Planned Unit Development. Internal PUD design standards are in Sec. 158.174; no fixed lot, coverage or setback envelope is printed for the district as a whole.

MPUD.note: Master Planned Unit Development, Secs. 158.185 to 158.196. Dimensional standards are established by the MPUD Conceptual Master Plan and Regulation Book required by Sec. 158.189; no fixed envelope is printed in the chapter.

coral_springs.name: Coral Springs
coral_springs.source: Land Development Code, Chapter 25 (Zoning), Articles II and IV-VII - per-district standards sections (there is no consolidated dimensional table); Downtown Mixe

gen.cite: Permanent and portable accessory generators
gen.text: Sec. 250129(1)(m): "Permanent and portable accessory generators must be a minimum of five (5) feet from any property line and fifteen (15) feet from any street right-of-way as close to the main structure as possible and still remain a safe enough distance not to create a hazard near openings to such structure and never beyond the front line of the main structure."

gen.cite: Screening of generators, A/C compressors, propane tanks, pumps and transformers
gen.text: Sec. 250129(4)(a): "Storage areas shall be screened with hedges, walls or fencing materials and be located so as to be substantially hidden from view at eye level from adjacent properties and street rights-of-way. Such screening shall be deemed necessary and adequate for areas occupied by air-conditioning compressors, generators, above ground propane tanks, pumps, transformers, and other similar equipment as well as for the storage of refuse or garbage containers of a size capable of being carried without use of mechanical equipment. All properties shall comply with this regulation by March, 2000."

equip.cite: Mechanical and plumbing equipment, A/C compressors, irrigation and pool pumps
equip.text: Sec. 250129(1)(a)5: "Mechanical and plumbing equipment including air conditioner compressors, lawn irrigation pumps, swimming pool accessories, and other equipment customarily associated with residential uses of land may be located within a side yard up to four (4) feet from a side plot line, but not forward of a line extended across the width of the plot at the front wall of the main structure closest to a street."

equip.cite: Accessory structures outside the rear yard, and propane tanks
equip.text: Sec. 250129(1)(b): "All accessory structures permitted to be located in other than the rear yard in residential districts shall be at least four (4) feet from a side plot line, ten (10) feet from a side corner plot line, and at least fifteen (15) feet from a front plot line. All conduits, electrical meters, air conditioners, plumbing, and pipes shall be enclosed or painted the same color as the adjacent structure. Underground equipment, such as propane tanks, or similar, are permitted in the front yard and are required to be four (4) feet from a side plot line and ten (10) feet from any street side plot line."

equip.cite: Essential services
equip.text: Sec. 250129(1)(a)4: "Accessory buildings and structures for essential services which shall not be subject to the dimensional requirements of any zoning district, but shall be subject to the city engineer's locational requirements."

equip.cite: Default accessory structure setback
equip.text: Sec. 250129(1)(a): "Except as provided below or elsewhere in this chapter, all accessory structures in residential districts shall be located in rear yards no closer than five (5) feet to the rear plot line and all accessory structures in nonresidential districts shall be located on that half of the plot the farthest distance-wise from any abutting street or streets, unless located within the building area." Sec. 250129(1)(f): "Where no other provision is applicable, no accessory structure excepting fences and walls, shall be located within five (5) feet of any plot line nor placed within any easement or placed within any right-of-way." Sec. 250129(1)(d): an accessory building or structure shall not be of greater height than the principal building on the plot, except in industrial districts and for corporate park uses. Sec. 250129(1)(e): accessory structures shall not occupy more than 35 per cent of required yard area.

equip.cite: Roof-mounted equipment
equip.text: Sec. 250129(1)(h): "Roof-mounted accessory structures, including but not limited to air conditioning systems, shall be screened and be located so as to be substantially hidden from view at eye level from street rights-of-way and any adjacent residential properties... Roof-mounted equipment shall be compatible with, or painted the same color as, the building." Sec. 1805 height exclusions: "Mechanical equipment rooms, penthouses, towers, cupolas, steeples and domes not exceeding in gross area, at maximum horizontal section, thirty (30) per cent of the roof area may exceed the permissible zoning by not more than twenty (20) feet."

equip.cite: Nonresidential mechanical equipment screening
equip.text: Sec. 250154(4)(g) (mixed-use developments) and the DT-MU general design standards, Sec. 2501061: "Electrical and mechanical equipment shall be effectively screened from view from public areas, streets, adjoining properties and residential uses"; "Building equipment at ground level shall be placed on the parking lot side of the building away from view from any streets, sidewalks and residential areas. The mechanical equipment shall be screened from view by fencing, vegetation, or parapet walls (if located on a roof) using the same materials as the principal building..."

equip.cite: Zero lot line dwellings
equip.text: Sec. 250148: accessory buildings and structures permitted on individual zero lot line dwelling sites are limited to garages, enclosed storage buildings, pools, spas, hot tubs, decks, cabanas, screen enclosures, walls, fences, awnings, trellises, "and mechanical equipment with its enclosure, provided that any accessory walls, fences or other structures are finished in the same or compatible materials and colors as the principal dwelling."

A-1.heightNote: Sec. 250173: "No structure shall be constructed to a height exceeding one foot for each five (5) feet of setback provided from that point of the structure to the property line." No fixed foot limit is printed.
A-1.note: Limited Agricultural. Sec. 250176: "No structure shall be located closer than fifty (50) feet to any property line" - one figure governs front, side and rear. 250174. Sec. 250177: livestock structures not within 100 ft of any plot line (a stable for not over 4 horses may be 50 ft from a side or rear plot line); poultry structures not within 100 ft of any plot line.

RS-1.note: Estate. Sec. 250223: plot not less than 150 ft in width and one (1) acre in area (43,560 sf); minimum frontage measured along the street is 24 ft. Corner plots: front yard as specified plus a side yard at least 25 ft on the side abutting the side street. Accessory shelter for horses at least 50 ft from any plot line (Sec. 250222(2)(c)). Minimum floor area 2,500 sf.

RS-3.note: One-Family Dwellings, Division 3. The division heading in the body reads "RS-3, RS-4 and RS-5"; the table of contents prints it as "R-3, RS-4 and RS-5" - a typo in the TOC. Corner plots: side yard at least 15 ft on the side abutting the side street. Nonresidential uses: side yard 20 ft plus 1 ft for each foot of height over 20 ft; rear yard 25 ft. Minimum frontage 24 ft measured along the street.

RS-4.note: Corner plots: side yard at least 15 ft on the side abutting the side street. Nonresidential uses: side yard 20 ft plus 1 ft per foot of height over 20 ft; rear yard 25 ft. Minimum frontage 24 ft. Minimum floor area 1,500 sf.

RS-5.note: Corner plots: side yard at least 15 ft on the side abutting the side street. Nonresidential uses: side yard 20 ft plus 1 ft per foot of height over 20 ft; rear yard 25 ft. Minimum frontage 24 ft. Minimum floor area 1,350 sf.

RS-6.note: Special One-Family (villa project). The setbacks are project-boundary setbacks, not per-lot: Sec. Accessory structures may be no less than 10 ft from a property line adjacent to any canal or lake greater than 40 ft in width. Sec. 250267(2): except on the project boundary, no structure less than 10 ft from any rear lot line, any other structure, any street, alley, driveaisle or parking lot or any canal or lake.

RC-6.heightNote: Sec. 250283: 25 ft for structures located at least 25 ft from the project property line; 35 ft for structures at least 100 ft from the project property line; 50 ft for structures at least 200 ft from the project property line.
RC-6.note: Residential Cluster. Sec. 250286(3): "No building or structure shall be erected closer than twenty-five (25) feet to the project property line and no closer than ten (10) feet to any interior vehicular accessways" - one figure governs front, side and rear, measured to the project property line. No plot-coverage percentage is printed; instead a minimum of 50 per cent of the parcel must be usable open area in RC-6.

RC-12.heightNote: Sec. 250283: 25 ft for structures located at least 25 ft from the project property line; 35 ft at least 100 ft from the project property line; 50 ft at least 200 ft from the project property line.
RC-12.note: Same envelope as RC-6 (Division 5 applies to RC-6, RC-12 and RC-15 alike). Minimum 45 per cent of the parcel as usable open area; no plot-coverage percentage printed. Plot area per dwelling unit: the code prints an internal contradiction here - "three thousand six hundred thirty (3,360) square feet in RC-12"; the words say 3,630 and the numeral says 3,360, so no figure is recorded.

RC-15.heightNote: Sec. 250283: 25 ft for structures located at least 25 ft from the project property line; 35 ft at least 100 ft from the project property line; 50 ft at least 200 ft from the project property line.
RC-15.note: Same envelope as RC-6 and RC-12. Minimum 45 per cent of the parcel as usable open area; no plot-coverage percentage printed. Plot area per dwelling unit 2,904 sf.

RD-8.note: Two-Family Dwelling. Setbacks recorded are for the principal structure, residential uses. Nonresidential uses: front 30, side 20, rear 20, and every nonresidential plot at least one acre. Corner plots: front 25, street side yard 15. Accessory structure height limited to 12.5 ft.

RM-15.frontNote: Sec. 250327: residential - not less than 50 ft if abutting an arterial roadway on the Broward County Trafficways Plan, or not less than 25 ft, or a depth equal to the height of the building, whichever is greater. Nonresidential - not less than 30 ft.
RM-15.sideNote: Sec. 250328 sets seven different side yards keyed to plot size, use, and whether the side abuts an RS, RC-6 or RD zoned plot: 10 ft (residential, plot under 1 acre); 15 ft or half the building height, whichever is greater (residential, non-abutting sides); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height over 20 ft (nonresidential, non-abutting); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height (nonresidential under 1 acre abutting).
RM-15.rearNote: Sec. 250329: 20 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of building height over 20 ft (residential, non-abutting); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft over 20 ft (nonresidential, non-abutting); on plots under 5 acres abutting an RS, RC-6 or RD plot, 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height (nonresidential) or 20 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height (residential); on plots 5 acres or more abutting, 60 / 40 / 25 ft by building storey as above.
RM-15.heightNote: Sec. 250326: 35 ft with a maximum of three stories on plots of five acres or more; 25 ft with a maximum of two stories on plots of less than five acres. A steeple or tower of a place of worship may reach 75 ft, with all yards increased 1 ft for every 1 ft of height above 50 ft.
RM-15.note: Low Medium Density Multiple-Family. Sec. 250324: minimum plot one acre with a minimum width of 100 ft; for multiple dwellings the minimum plot is five acres with a minimum depth and width of 300 ft. Street yards (Sec. 250330): any side or rear yard abutting a street takes the greater of the front yard or the applicable side/rear requirement, except plots under one acre get a 20 ft street side yard.

RM-20.frontNote: Sec. 250357: residential - not less than 50 ft if abutting an arterial roadway, or not less than 25 ft, or a depth equal to the height of the building, whichever is greater. Nonresidential - not less than 30 ft or a depth equal to the height of the building, whichever is greater.
RM-20.sideNote: Sec. 250358: 15 ft or one-half the height of the building, whichever is greater (residential, non-abutting); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height over 20 ft (nonresidential, non-abutting); on plots under 5 acres abutting an RS, RC-6 or RD plot, 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height (nonresidential) or 25 ft (residential).
RM-20.rearNote: Sec. 250359: 20 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height over 20 ft (residential, non-abutting); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft over 20 ft (nonresidential, non-abutting); on plots under 5 acres abutting, 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height (nonresidential) or 20 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height (residential); on plots 5 acres or more abutting, 60 / 40 / 25 ft by building storey.
RM-20.heightNote: Sec. 250356: 35 ft with a maximum of three stories; plots of less than five acres are further restricted to 25 ft with a maximum of two stories. Steeple or tower of a place of worship may reach 75 ft, with all yards increased 1 ft per 1 ft of height above 50 ft.
RM-20.note: Medium Density Multiple-Family. Minimum plot one acre, minimum width 100 ft; for multiple dwellings five acres with minimum depth and width of 300 ft. Maximum building length 160 ft.

RM-30.frontNote: Sec. 250387: residential - not less than 50 ft if abutting an arterial roadway, or not less than 25 ft, or a depth equal to the height of the building, whichever is greater. Nonresidential - not less than 30 ft or a depth equal to the height of the building, whichever is greater.
RM-30.sideNote: Sec. 250388: 15 ft or one-half the height of the building, whichever is greater (residential, non-abutting); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height over 20 ft (nonresidential, non-abutting).
RM-30.rearNote: Sec. 250389: 20 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height over 20 ft (residential, non-abutting); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft over 20 ft (nonresidential, non-abutting); where abutting, 60 ft or the height of the building whichever is greater (residential 3 stories or more, or nonresidential over 25 ft), 40 ft (2-story), 25 ft (1-story).
RM-30.note: Medium High Density Multiple-Family. Sec. 250386: 80 ft maximum, except that one level of understory parking may be added and is not counted toward maximum height or as a story for coverage. 250385 table: one-story 30, two-story 30, three-story 30, four-story 28, five-story 26, six-story 24, seven-story 22, eight-story 20, nine-story 18 per cent.

RM-40.frontNote: Sec. 250417: residential - not less than 50 ft if abutting an arterial roadway, or not less than 25 ft, or a depth equal to the height of the building, whichever is greater. Nonresidential - not less than 30 ft or a depth equal to the height of the building, whichever is greater.
RM-40.sideNote: Sec. 250418: 15 ft or one-half the height of the building, whichever is greater (residential, non-abutting); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height over 20 ft (nonresidential, non-abutting); where abutting an RS, RC-6 or RD plot, 60 ft or the height of the building whichever is greater (residential 3 stories or more, or nonresidential over 25 ft), 40 ft (2-story), 25 ft (1-story residential).
RM-40.rearNote: Sec. 250419: 20 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft of height over 20 ft (residential, non-abutting); 25 ft plus 1 ft per 2 ft over 20 ft (nonresidential, non-abutting); where abutting, 60 / 40 / 25 ft by building storey as for side yards.
RM-40.note: High Density Multiple-Family. Sec. 250416: 120 ft maximum, except that one level of understory parking may be added and is not counted toward maximum height or as a story for coverage. 250415 table: one- through three-story 30, four-story 28, five-story 26, six-story 24, seven-story 22, eight-story 20, nine-story 18, ten-story 16, eleven-story 14, twelve-story 12, thirteen-story or above 10 per cent.

B-1.sideNote: Sec. 250458: "Every plot shall have a street side yard of not less than twenty (20) feet in depth. There is no side yard setback for a plot which is not adjacent to a street or alley." So 20 ft on a street side and no required interior side yard.
B-1.rearNote: Sec. 250458(4): "Where a plot abuts a dedicated alley, a rear yard of not less than ten (10) feet shall be provided." No rear yard is stated for a plot that does not abut an alley.
B-1.note: Neighborhood Business. Sec. 250457: "There shall be no minimum required width or area of plot."

B-2.sideNote: Sec. 250573(2): street side yard not less than 20 ft. No interior side yard figure is printed.
B-2.rearNote: Sec. 250573(5): "Where a plot abuts a dedicated alley, a rear yard of not less than ten (10) feet shall be provided." No rear yard is stated otherwise.
B-2.note: Community Business. Front yard: 65 ft, except not less than 25 ft where the front plot line is adjacent to a right-of-way less than 60 ft wide, and no front setback is required where the front 65 ft or more has been conveyed to the city under the master parking plan. Height: Sec.

B-3.sideNote: Sec. 250593(2): street side yard not less than 20 ft. No interior side yard figure is printed.
B-3.rearNote: Sec. 250593(5): "Where a plot abuts a dedicated alley, a rear yard of not less than ten (10) feet shall be provided."
B-3.note: General Business. No front setback is required where the front 65 ft or more has been conveyed to the city under the master parking plan. Height: Sec.

IC.sideNote: Sec. 250623(2): every plot having a street side shall have a street side yard of not less than 20 ft. No interior side yard figure is printed; Sec. 250623(3) instead requires that no structure be located closer than 100 ft from any residentially zoned land.
IC.rearNote: No rear yard figure is printed. Sec. 250623(3): no structure closer than 100 ft from any residentially zoned land.
IC.note: Industrial Commercial. Sec. 250622: "There shall be no minimum required size of plots." No front setback is required where the front 65 ft or more has been conveyed to the city under the master parking plan. Walls except on an interior side or rear plot line need a landscaped setback of at least 20 ft; walls, dumpsters, fences or hedges over 3 ft in height no closer than 10 ft from a dedicated right-of-way.

IRD.sideNote: Sec. 250642 prints only a street-line setback: "No building or roofed structure shall be located less than fifty (50) feet from any street line." No interior side yard is printed.
IRD.rearNote: Sec. 250642 prints no rear yard; only the 50 ft street-line setback.
IRD.note: Industrial, Research and Development. Minimum landscaped open space 30 per cent of plot; landscape strip at least 25 ft between an abutting right-of-way and off-street parking. No more than half the depth of a required setback may be used for parking, and that parking must be on the half of the setback furthest from the street or front plot line.

EC.note: Employment Center. Sec. 250678(1): "No building or roofed structure shall be located less than fifty (50) feet from any street line nor less than twenty-five (25) feet from any plot line other than a street line." Sec. 250676: the minimum area for an EC District as a whole is 40 acres. Sec. 250677: every plot not less than 100 ft wide and not less than one acre in area.

MC.note: Medical Center. Height: 50 ft for anything other than a hospital, except no structure over 25 ft within 150 ft of an RS District; hospitals are limited to 150 ft. Front/street yard 25 ft, increased 1 ft for each additional 2 ft of height where the building exceeds 25 ft. Side yard 15 ft, but 25 ft where the side yard abuts a street, increased 1 ft for every 2 ft of building height over 25 ft.

GC.note: Golf Course and Recreation. Sec. No building closer than 50 ft to any one-family zoning district. Buildings over 20 ft in height require one additional foot of setback for each foot of height over 20 ft. No parking area within 20 ft of any residentially zoned property nor within 5 ft of any street line. Plot coverage: "No more than one and one-half percent (1.5%) of the plot shall be under roof."

P.note: Parks and Recreation. Sec. 250736: no building or roofed structure greater than 100 sf closer than 25 ft to any plot line; no structure except fences or walls within 20 ft of any residentially zoned property nor within 25 ft of any street line; no parking area within 20 ft of residentially zoned property nor within 5 ft of any street line.

CF-G.note: Community Facility General. Sec. 250753: no building or roofed structure closer than 25 ft to any property line; no structure except fences or walls within 20 ft of any residentially zoned property or within 25 ft of any right-of-way line; no parking area within 20 ft of residentially zoned property or within 5 ft of any street line.

CF-E.note: Community Facility Educational. Sec. 250769: no building or roofed structure closer than 25 ft to any property line; no structure except fences or walls within 20 ft of any residentially zoned property or within 25 ft of any right-of-way line; no parking area within 20 ft of residentially zoned property or within 5 ft of any right-of-way line.

SU.note: Special Utility. Division 8 (Secs. 250781-250784) prints no dimensional standards at all - only purpose, permitted uses, conditional uses and prohibited uses. Sec. 250784(2) prohibits "any buildings or roofed structures" in the district, and (1) prohibits any use, mechanical equipment or activity creating excessive noise, light, odor or vibration that is a nuisance to occupants of contiguous residential plots.

GU.sideNote: Sec. 250800 prints no general plot-line setback: "No structure, except fences or walls..., shall be located within twenty (20) feet of any residentially zoned property or within twenty-five (25) feet of any right-of-way line."
GU.rearNote: Same as side - only the 20 ft from residentially zoned property and 25 ft from a right-of-way line are printed.
GU.note: General Utility. No parking area within 20 ft of any residentially zoned property or within 5 ft of any street line. No height limit and no minimum plot size are printed for GU.

DT-MU.frontNote: Downtown Mixed-Use is form-based. Sec. 2501059 gives a street setback BAND per building type and per street, not a single setback: Townhome - Sample Road 10 min / 25 max, University Drive N/A, Secondary Roads 10 / 25; Multi-Plex Small, Medium and Large and Commercial/Mixed-Use Medium - 10 / 20 on each street (Commercial/Mixed-Use Medium is 0 / 20 on University Drive).
DT-MU.sideNote: Sec. 2501059 side setbacks by building type (min / max): Townhome 0 / - (10 ft separation required from an adjacent detached building; no more than 8 units attached without an additional 20 ft side setback); Multi-Plex Small 0 / - (10 ft separation from adjacent detached building); Multi-Plex Medium 0 / 10; Multi-Plex Large 5 / -; Commercial/Mixed-Use Small 0 / 6; Commercial/Mixed-Use Medium 0 / -; Mid-Rise 0 / -.
DT-MU.rearNote: Sec. 2501059 rear setbacks by building type (minimum): Townhome 15; Multi-Plex Small 10; Multi-Plex Medium 10; Multi-Plex Large 15; Commercial/Mixed-Use Small 5; Commercial/Mixed-Use Medium 10; Mid-Rise 10; High-Rise 10; Single Story Commercial 15; Civic-Institution 15.
DT-MU.heightNote: Heights are given in stories, not feet (Sec. 2501059, principal building min / max): Townhome 1 / 3; Multi-Plex Small 1 / 3; Multi-Plex Medium 2 / 4; Multi-Plex Large 2 / 5; Commercial/Mixed-Use Small 2 / 4; Commercial/Mixed-Use Medium 2 / 5 (4 if adjacent to a single-family residential zoning district and within the Edge subdistrict).
DT-MU.note: Downtown Mixed-Use, Article XVII. Three subdistricts - Downtown Core, Downtown General, Downtown Edge - which control which building types are permitted, not the dimensions; the dimensions come from the building type. Lot requirements by building type (width min/max ft, depth min/max ft, size min/max sf, max lot coverage %): Townhome 15-25 (end unit up to 10 ft), 80-120, 1,600-3,500, 60.

west_palm_beach.name: West Palm Beach
west_palm_beach.source: Code of Ordinances, Chapter 94 (Zoning and Land Development Regulations) -- NOT REPRINTED IN THIS VOLUME. Chapter 94 is carried as a one-page placeholder only.
west_palm_beach.offsite: The zoning chapter is not in this jurisdiction's Municode document — the copy held here is a supplement or a stub. The current code is published on enCodePlus. Nothing on this card is a setback for this jurisdiction; read the adopted code before siting anything.

equip.cite: Generators supporting wireless equipment boxes in the public right-of-way (Sec. 78-411(h), PDF p.980)
equip.text: "No generators to support equipment boxes may be placed in the public right-of-way except temporarily, in case of emergency, and approved in advance by the city's engineering services division." (This governs communications-facility equipment in the right-of-way only; it is not a general accessory-equipment setback.)

sunrise.name: Sunrise
sunrise.source: Code of Ordinances, Subpart B -- City of Sunrise Land Development Code, Chapter 16, Article V, District Regulations (Secs. 16-69 through 16-109). Per-district s

gen.cite: Generators (Sec. 16-130(a), PDF p.1053)
gen.text: "Generators. Generators (other than on single-family lots) shall be screened by a wall or fence of a height equal to or greater than the generator and, where practicable as determined by the director of community development, landscaped by mid-level landscaping not less than twenty-four (24) inches in height and upper-level landscaping not less than thirty (30) inches on height at time of installation: (1) Walls shall have architectural details and colors that are consistent with other structures within the project. (2) Fencing shall be shadow box or vinyl-clad chain link with slats of a color that is consistent with other structures within the project." NOTE: this is a screening rule, not a setback. The code sets NO separation distance for a generator from a property line, a window or an air intake.

gen.cite: Fence/wall height for generator enclosures (Sec. 16-195, PDF p.1131)
gen.text: "Nonresidential districts. Unless lower heights are specified in the requirements of section 16-192 above, no fence or wall shall exceed ten (10) feet except as for generator enclosures, compactor enclosures, transformer substation buffering and other such accessory uses, subject to administrative approval by the department."

gen.cite: Accessory structures generally (Sec. 16-118(a)(1)-(2), PDF p.1040)
gen.text: "Location: In all districts, accessory building such as garages, servants' quarters, cabanas, sheds, or similar structures, where permitted as accessory to the main structure, shall comply with the setback and other restrictions for the district in which they are located except: a. A storage shed not more than nine (9) feet in height and not more than one hundred (100) square feet in floor area. The shed may be located in a side or rear yard provided that the adjacent property line does not abut a public or private right-of-way, and the shed is set back a minimum of five (5) feet." "Height: No accessory structures shall exceed two (2) stories or twenty-four (24) feet in height, and no accessory building shall be erected previous to the erection of the principal building." -- A generator on a pad is not named in this section; a ground-mounted generator therefore has no express accessory-structure setback other than the district setback.

gen.cite: Generators in the public right-of-way for communications facilities (Sec. 7-287(h), PDF p.562)
gen.text: "No generators utilized in connection with communications services may be placed in the public rights-of-way, except temporarily in the case of emergency and with notification to the community development department."

gen.cite: Generators as a minor site-plan adjustment (Sec. 16-38 area, PDF p.915)
gen.text: Generators are listed among the "[e]xamples of minor adjustments that can be approved administratively" to an approved site plan, alongside dumpster enclosure revisions and minor architectural elevation changes.

equip.cite: Screening of other mechanical equipment (Sec. 16-130, opening paragraph, PDF p.1053)
equip.text: "All mechanical, electrical or air conditioning equipment shall be screened from view on all sides by an architectural, structural or landscaping barrier consistent in design and construction with the other structures within the project. Air conditioning equipment for single-family attached and detached homes, two-family dwelling, villas and townhouses need not be screened from view when located on the ground."

equip.cite: Public utilities and ground-mounted equipment (Sec. 16-122, PDF p.1047)
equip.text: "Utilities necessary to the public health and convenience such as gas, electric, and telephone lines, minor equipment and appurtenances (for example, transformer boxes and switch gear) and mains may be located in any district subject to landscaping and building requirements of the district and other landscaping and building requirements as deemed necessary by the city commission to protect the public health, safety and welfare. In any case, a hedge shall be planted along three (3) sides of any transformer box or other similar ground-mounted equipment."

equip.cite: Transformer substations (Sec. 16-129, PDF p.1052)
equip.text: "(a) The plot shall be provided with a yard not less than fifty (50) feet in depth or width adjacent to all street lines and not less than thirty (30) feet adjacent to all other plot lines. The yards required under this paragraph shall be fully landscaped as specified below, and shall not be used for any fence, wall, building or structure... (b) A decorative wall, a minimum of eight (8) feet in height, shall screen all exposed equipment areas abutting external streets."

equip.cite: Mechanical equipment near dwelling entrances, RM-10 (Sec. 16-71(k)(12), PDF p.961)
equip.text: "Mechanical equipment larger than eight hundred (800) cubic inches in volume when measured from its extremities shall not be installed near the entrances to individual dwelling units or approachways to them. This provision shall not apply to essential emergency equipment such as fire extinguishers and alarm boxes." (The same design-standards clause is carried in RM-16 and RM-25.)

equip.cite: Swimming pools, hot tubs and screen enclosures (Sec. 16-118(b), PDF p.1040-1041)
equip.text: "Pools and hot tubs shall not be placed in a required front or street side yard setback. The water's edge of a pool or hot tub shall not be within five (5) feet of any side or rear plot line..." "No pool, hot tub, screen enclosure or deck shall be placed within a utility or drainage easement." No separate placement rule is printed for pool PUMPS or pool equipment.

equip.cite: Propane storage as an accessory use (Sec. 16-118(f)(2), PDF p.1043)
equip.text: Retail sale/exchange of propane in portable pre-filled containers is permitted accessory to a stand-alone retail store, gasoline station or gas station/convenience store only, with "[a]ll containers, not to exceed thirty-six (36) individual twenty (20) pound cylinders... stored in a purpose built metal storage cage approved for propane storage by the city's fire rescue department" and, absent an outdoor enclosed area, "propane storage shall be located on an exterior rear or side facing wall of a principal building in a location that does not impact pedestrian circulation... and is not visible from a public right-of-way." "Sale of propane fuel directly from a freestanding or in-ground storage tank... shall be prohibited" except in the narrow case described.

equip.cite: Height exclusions for mechanical roof structures (Sec. 16-119, PDF p.1046)
equip.text: "Stairs, equipment towers, cupolas, steeples and domes, the maximum gross area of the horizontal section of which does not exceed twenty-five (25) percent of the roof area, airplane beacons, chimneys, stacks, tanks and roof structures used only for ornamental and/or mechanical purposes may exceed the permissible height limit in any district, to a maximum of twenty-five (25) percent of the maximum allowable height."

equip.cite: Setback waiver (Sec. 16-120, PDF p.1046)
equip.text: "The director of community development, or his/her designee, may waive any setback distance by up to ten (10) percent up to one (1) foot in recognition of unique constraints and specific development conditions that may apply to a site." (A 10 percent waiver capped at one foot.)

RS-3.sideNote: "At least ten (10) feet in width, provided however, that a developer may choose to provide a seven and one-half (7 1/2) foot yard on one (1) side and a twelve and one-half (12 1/2) foot yard on the other side."
RS-3.rearNote: "Not less than fifteen (15) feet in depth, except when abutting a waterway or another street (through-lot) where said required yard shall be not less than twenty-five (25) feet. Open mesh screen enclosures shall be set back at least fifteen (15) feet on through-lots."
RS-3.heightNote: "Height not to exceed either two (2) stories or twenty-five (25) feet." (§ 16-69(f)).
RS-3.note: Residential uses. Minimum floor area 1,800 sq ft. Coverage 40% is stated as "Percentage of Maximum Lot Coverage (Principal and Accessory Buildings)". Minimum landscaped or pervious area 30%. Corner lots: front yard as specified plus a side yard at least 20 ft on the side abutting the side street. Density max 3 du/gross acre. § 16-69.

RS-5.rearNote: "Not less than fifteen (15) feet in depth, except when abutting a waterway or another street (through-lot) where said required yard shall be not less than twenty-five (25) feet."
RS-5.heightNote: "Height not to exceed either two (2) stories or twenty-five (25) feet." (§ 16-69(f)).
RS-5.note: Residential uses. "At least seven and one-half (7 1/2) feet on each side." Minimum floor area 1,400 sq ft. Pervious 30%. Corner lots: side yard at least 20 ft on the side street. Density max 5 du/gross acre. § 16-69.

RS-3 and RS-5 (nonresidential uses).sideNote: "Not less than twenty (20) feet in width, with an increase of one (1) foot in width of each side yard for each two (2) feet in height of the structure in excess of twenty (20) feet."
RS-3 and RS-5 (nonresidential uses).note: The lot table in § 16-69(d) carries a third row, "Non-Residential Uses", with Minimum Lot Area 20,000 sq. ft., Minimum Floor Area N/A, Minimum Lot Width 100 ft., and Maximum Lot Coverage 50. "Every plot whose principal use is nonresidential shall have a [rear] yard not less than twenty (20) feet in depth."

RS-7.frontNote: "Not less than twenty-five (25) feet in depth from the back edge of the sidewalk" (measured from the sidewalk, not the right-of-way).
RS-7.sideNote: "Residential uses: There shall be no required side yard setback from property lines. There shall be, however, a minimum distance of fifteen (15) feet between buildings." (§ 16-70(k)(3)).
RS-7.rearNote: "Residential and accessory uses: Not less than fifteen (15) feet in depth, except when abutting a waterway or another street (through-lot) where said required yard shall not be less than twenty-five (25) feet."
RS-7.heightNote: "No building or structure, or part thereof, shall exceed either two (2) stories or twenty-five (25) feet." (§ 16-70(h)).
RS-7.note: Single-Family Planned Development District. Minimum plot size for the development as a whole is 3 acres. Minimum floor area 1,200 sq ft. Pervious 30%. Density max 7 du/gross acre. County trafficway (any yard): at least 50 ft from the right-of-way. Corner plots: side yard at least 20 ft on the side street. § 16-70.

RS-7 (nonresidential uses).sideNote: "On each side, not less than twenty (20) feet in width, with an increase of one (1) foot in width of each side yard for each two (2) feet in height of the structure or fraction thereof in excess of twenty (20) feet."
RS-7 (nonresidential uses).note: § 16-70(e)(2), (k). Front measured from the back edge of the sidewalk.

RM-10.sideNote: "Residential uses: on each side, each of which shall be at least ten (10) feet in width, provided that where a two-family or townhouse dwelling is erected on two (2) platted lots with a dividing party wall centered on the common lot line between the two (2) platted lots, a side yard shall not be required adjacent to and on either side of said common lot line." Nonresidential: on each side not less than 20 ft, plus 1 ft per each 2 ft of height over 20 ft.
RM-10.rearNote: "Residential uses: Not less than twenty (20) feet in depth, except twenty-five (25) feet in the case of through-lots. Nonresidential uses: Not less than twenty-five (25) feet in depth."
RM-10.heightNote: "Shall not exceed either two (2) stories or twenty-five (25) feet, except that: 1) a residential building may be three (3) stories and thirty-five (35) feet high, whichever is less, provided that it is separated from the nearest single-family residential district by at least one hundred (100) feet: and 2) a steeple or tower on a church may extend to a height of not more than fifty (50) feet." (§ 16-71(g.
RM-10.minLotNote: Plot size varies by dwelling type (§ 16-71(d)): zero lot line single-family -- not less than 160 ft wide, 250 ft deep and 43,560 sq ft, but where each unit and the land under it is separately owned, each unit may be on a lot not less than 50 ft wide and 100 ft deep.
RM-10.note: Low Medium Multifamily Residential. No lot-coverage percentage is stated for this district; minimum pervious landscaped area is 35%. Front: residential and accessory 25 ft, nonresidential 40 ft. County trafficway (any yard): at least 50 ft. Corner plots: side yard at least 20 ft on the side street.

RM-16 (at edge of development).heightNote: "Not to exceed twelve (12) stories or one hundred twenty (120) feet in height, whichever is less, provided that such buildings are separated from the nearest single-family residential development by at least one hundred (100) feet plus two (2) feet for every foot in height over thirty-five (35) feet and provided that such buildings are separated from the nearest public right-of-way or designated open space by the setback required by section (i) below plus at least two (2) feet for every one (1) foot in height above thirty-five (35) feet." (§ 16-72(g)).
RM-16 (at edge of development).note: The 50 ft figure is the code's own "Residential and nonresidential uses at the edge of a development" row for front, side and rear. Plot: not less than 160 ft wide, 250 ft deep and 43,560 sq ft. Pervious 35%. No lot-coverage percentage stated. Density max 16 du/gross acre. County trafficway (any yard): at least 50 ft. § 16-72(j).

RM-16 (not at edge of development).frontNote: Residential and accessory uses 25 ft; nonresidential uses 40 ft. "The depth of 'yards not at the edge of a development' shall be measured from public or private right-of-way lines internal to the development."
RM-16 (not at edge of development).sideNote: "Residential uses not at the edge of a development: On each side, at least fifteen (15) feet in width for one (1) story structures, and which side yards shall be increased five (5) feet for each floor above the first floor of the building." Nonresidential not at edge: not less than 25 ft, increased 5 ft per floor above the first. Corner plots not at edge: side yard at least 20 ft on the side street.
RM-16 (not at edge of development).rearNote: "Residential uses not at the edge of a development: Not less than twenty (20) feet in depth for a one (1) story structure and such rear yard shall be increased five (5) feet for each floor above the first floor of the building. Residential uses adjacent to recreation, open space, or lakes and other water bodies: Not less than twenty-five (25) feet in depth.
RM-16 (not at edge of development).heightNote: Same proviso as the at-edge regime; see "RM-16 (at edge of development)".
RM-16 (not at edge of development).note: Side and rear values above are the one-story figures; both step up 5 ft per storey. Pervious 35%. § 16-72(j).

RM-25 (at edge of development).heightNote: "Not to exceed twelve (12) stories or one hundred twenty (120) feet in height, whichever is less, provided that such buildings are separated from the nearest single-family residential development by at least one hundred (100) feet plus two (2) feet for every foot in height over thirty-five (35) feet, and provided that such buildings are separated from the nearest public right-of-way or designated open space by the setback required by subsection (i) below plus at least two (2) feet for every one (1) foot in height above thirty-five (35) feet." (§ 16-73(g)).
RM-25 (at edge of development).note: Plot: not less than 160 ft wide, 250 ft deep and 43,560 sq ft. Pervious 35%. No lot-coverage percentage stated. Density max 25 du/gross acre. County trafficway (any yard): at least 50 ft. § 16-73(j).

RM-25 (not at edge of development).frontNote: Residential and accessory uses 25 ft; nonresidential uses 40 ft.
RM-25 (not at edge of development).sideNote: "Multiple dwellings and accessory uses not at the edge of a development: On each side, at least fifteen (15) feet in width, and such side yards shall be increased five (5) feet for each floor above the first floor of the building." Nonresidential not at edge: not less than 25 ft, increased 5 ft per floor above the first. Corner plots not at edge: side yard at least 25 ft on the side street.
RM-25 (not at edge of development).rearNote: "Residential and accessory uses not at the edge of a development: Not less than twenty (20) feet in depth and such rear yard shall be increased five (5) feet for each floor above the first floor of the building. Residential uses adjacent to recreation, open space, or lakes and other water bodies: Not less than twenty-five (25) feet in depth.
RM-25 (not at edge of development).heightNote: Same proviso as the at-edge regime; see "RM-25 (at edge of development)".
RM-25 (not at edge of development).note: Side and rear values above are the first-floor figures; both step up 5 ft per storey. § 16-73(j).

RP-10.rearNote: "Not less than fifteen (15) feet in depth, except that there shall be twenty (20) feet setback when abutting a waterway."
RP-10.heightNote: "Not to exceed one (1) story or fifteen (15) feet, whichever is less." (§ 16-74(d)).
RP-10.note: Mobile Home Park District. Plot: not less than 200 ft in width and 1 acre in area (43,560 sq ft; converted from acres x 43,560). The 200-ft minimum width need not be measured at a street line if the plot extends to a street by a strip at least 60 ft wide. Individual mobile home site: not less than 3,200 sq ft and not less than 40 ft average width. Front yard depth required on all streets the plot abuts.

R/OS.frontNote: "No structure, except fences or walls as hereinafter provided, shall be located within fifty (50) feet of any residentially zoned property nor within seventy-five (75) feet of the right-of-way line of a trafficway as depicted on the trafficways plan as amended from time to time, or within twenty-five (25) feet of any other street right-of-way line." (§ 16-75(f)(2)).
R/OS.sideNote: "No building or roofed portion of any structure shall be located within twenty-five (25) feet of any plot line." (§ 16-75(f)(3)).
R/OS.rearNote: Same: 25 ft from any plot line per § 16-75(f)(3).
R/OS.note: Recreation/Open Space District. The code sets no conventional front/side/rear yards; it sets distances from residentially zoned property, trafficways, street rights-of-way and plot lines, recorded above verbatim. No parking area within 50 ft of any residentially zoned property nor within 25 ft of any street line. Plot size: "Not less than one hundred (100) feet in width" -- no minimum area is printed.

CR.frontNote: "Structure, except fences or walls as hereinafter provided, shall be located at least twenty-five (25) feet of any residentially zoned property, at least seventy-five (75) feet from the right-of-way line of a trafficway as depicted on the trafficways plan, as amended from time to time and within twenty-five (25) feet from any other street right-of-way line or plot line." (§ 16-76(f)(2)).
CR.sideNote: Same clause: 25 ft from any other street right-of-way line or plot line.
CR.rearNote: Same clause: 25 ft from any other street right-of-way line or plot line.
CR.heightNote: "Not to exceed fifty (50) feet unless the building is set back from all property lines a distance at least equal to the height of the building." (§ 16-76(d)).
CR.note: Commercial Recreation District. Parking areas at least 25 ft from any residentially zoned property or street line. No lot-coverage percentage stated. § 16-76.

CF.frontNote: "Adjacent to any trafficway, a yard of seventy-five (75) feet in width shall be provided. Adjacent to any street, excluding trafficways, a yard of twenty-five (25) feet in width shall be provided."
CF.sideNote: "A side yard of ten (10) feet in width shall be provided when not abutting a trafficway[;] any building in excess of twelve (12) feet in height, as measured from the first floor finished grade of the building to the highest portion of the building, shall provide an additional two (2) feet of side yard for every ten (10) feet, or fraction thereof, in additional height."
CF.rearNote: "A rear yard of twenty (20) feet in width shall be provided when not abutting a trafficway."
CF.heightNote: "Not to exceed ten (10) stories or one hundred (100) feet, whichever is less." (§ 16-77(e)).
CF.note: Community Facilities District. Plot: not less than 150 ft in width and 1 acre in area (43,560 sq ft; converted from acres x 43,560). No lot-coverage percentage stated. Required yards may be used only for walkways, parking of passenger cars, driveways and landscaping. § 16-77.

B-1.frontNote: "Adjacent to any trafficway, a yard of seventy-five (75) feet in width shall be provided. Adjacent to any street, excluding those trafficways, a yard of twenty-five (25) feet in width shall be provided." (§ 16-78(g)(1)-(2)).
B-1.sideNote: "A side yard of ten (10) feet in width shall be provided when not abutting a trafficway, and such side yard shall be increased another two (2) feet for each floor above the first floor of the building when abutting a nonresidential district and another five (5) feet for each floor above the first floor when abutting a residential district."
B-1.rearNote: "A rear yard of twenty (20) feet in depth shall be provided when not abutting a trafficway, and such rear yard shall be increased another five (5) feet for each floor above the first floor of the building."
B-1.heightNote: "In B-1 districts, the maximum building height shall be two (2) stories or thirty (30) feet, whichever is less." (§ 16-78(e)).
B-1.coverageNote: Lot coverage is a schedule keyed to building height, not one number (§ 16-78(h)(1)): One Story 35, Two Story 35, Three Story 35, Four Story 33, Five Story 32, Six Story 30, Seven Story 28, Eight Story 26, Nine Story 25, Ten to Twenty Stories 24 percent. Footnote 1: "Regional shopping center buildings and structures shall not exceed thirty-five (35) percent maximum lot coverage."
B-1.note: Neighborhood Business District. At least 15 percent of a commercial site shall be landscaped or pervious. FAR is a separate schedule by storey (1 story 0.35 to greater-than-four-stories 1.00, 2.00 in the Western Sunrise Area). § 16-78.

B-2.frontNote: Trafficway 75 ft; any other street 25 ft. (§ 16-78(g)).
B-2.sideNote: 10 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +2 ft per floor above the first when abutting a nonresidential district and +5 ft per floor when abutting a residential district.
B-2.rearNote: 20 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +5 ft per floor above the first.
B-2.heightNote: "In B-2 districts, the maximum building height shall be four (4) stories or sixty (60) feet, whichever is less." (§ 16-78(e)).
B-2.note: Community Business District. Plot 150 ft wide x 200 ft deep minimum. Pervious 15%. § 16-78.

B-3.frontNote: Trafficway 75 ft; any other street 25 ft.
B-3.sideNote: 10 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +2 ft per floor above the first when abutting a nonresidential district and +5 ft per floor when abutting a residential district.
B-3.rearNote: 20 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +5 ft per floor above the first.
B-3.heightNote: "In B-3, B-4, B-5, B-6, and B-7 districts, the maximum building height shall be two hundred fifty (250) feet." (§ 16-78(e)).
B-3.note: General Business District. Plot 150 ft wide x 200 ft deep minimum. Pervious 15%. § 16-78.

B-4.frontNote: Trafficway 75 ft; any other street 25 ft.
B-4.sideNote: 10 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +2 ft per floor above the first when abutting a nonresidential district and +5 ft per floor when abutting a residential district.
B-4.rearNote: 20 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +5 ft per floor above the first.
B-4.note: Professional Office District. Plot 150 ft wide x 200 ft deep minimum. Pervious 15%. Accessory retail/service limited to 10% of gross floor area. § 16-78.

B-5.frontNote: Trafficway 75 ft; any other street 25 ft.
B-5.sideNote: 10 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +2 ft per floor above the first when abutting a nonresidential district and +5 ft per floor when abutting a residential district.
B-5.rearNote: 20 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +5 ft per floor above the first.
B-5.note: Sunrise/Sawgrass Office District. Plot 150 ft wide x 200 ft deep minimum. Pervious 15%. § 16-78.

B-6.frontNote: Trafficway 75 ft; any other street 25 ft.
B-6.sideNote: 10 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +2 ft per floor above the first when abutting a nonresidential district and +5 ft per floor when abutting a residential district.
B-6.rearNote: 20 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +5 ft per floor above the first.
B-6.note: Sunrise/Sawgrass Mixed-Use District. Plot 150 ft wide x 200 ft deep minimum. Pervious 15%. § 16-78.

B-7.frontNote: "Adjacent to any trafficway, a yard of seventy-five (75) feet in width shall be provided. Within the B-7 District, adjacent to any trafficway with a minimum width of three hundred (300) feet, a yard of a minimum of ten (10) feet in width shall be provided." Adjacent to any other street, 25 ft.
B-7.sideNote: 10 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +2 ft per floor above the first when abutting a nonresidential district and +5 ft per floor when abutting a residential district.
B-7.rearNote: 20 ft when not abutting a trafficway, +5 ft per floor above the first.
B-7.coverageNote: Same height-keyed schedule as B-1, but footnote 2 adds: "A lot coverage waiver of up to fifty (50) percent of the standard may be granted in the B-7 district pursuant to subsection (k) of this section, for buildings eight (8) stories and greater in height."
B-7.note: Office Park District. Plot 150 ft wide x 200 ft deep minimum. Pervious 15%. § 16-78(k) allows administrative waivers of these development standards, but "[i]n no event shall [a waiver] result in a yard setback of less than ten (10) feet". § 16-78.

I-1.frontNote: The § 16-80(i) setback table has three columns. Residential District or Broward County Trafficway: front 75 ft. District Parcel (including other I-1 parcels and canal rights-of-way): front 25 ft. Other Street: front 25 ft.
I-1.sideNote: Residential District or Broward County Trafficway 75 ft; District Parcel 25 ft; Other Street 10 ft. Footnote: "Except if building exceeds twelve (12) feet in height, two (2) additional feet of setback shall be provided for every ten (10) feet of additional height."
I-1.rearNote: Residential District or Broward County Trafficway 75 ft; District Parcel 25 ft; Other Street 20 ft.
I-1.heightNote: "Not to exceed five (5) stories or seventy (70) feet, whichever is more. See section 16-119 for height exceptions." (§ 16-80(f)) -- note the code prints "whichever is more", not "whichever is less".
I-1.note: Light Industrial District. Minimum plot size 1 acre (43,560 sq ft; converted from acres x 43,560). Lot coverage: "The combined area occupied by all roofed structures shall not exceed forty (40) percent of the plot area." FAR schedule by storey, 1 story 0.35 up to 1.00 above four storeys (2.00 in the Western Sunrise Area). All utility transmission lines shall be installed underground except a main feeder line.

PUD.frontNote: "There are no required setbacks or yards except there shall be a building setback or yard of not less than thirty (30) feet in depth from the perimeter edge of the PUD." (§ 16-101(d)(6)).
PUD.sideNote: Same clause: no required yards except a 30 ft perimeter setback.
PUD.rearNote: Same clause: no required yards except a 30 ft perimeter setback.
PUD.heightNote: "The maximum height of a structure shall be five (5) stories or eighty (80) feet, whichever is greater. Where any perimeter of a PUD is adjacent to existing single-family units, the maximum height for any proposed building in the PUD located within one hundred (100) feet of that perimeter shall be thirty-five (35) feet." (§ 16-101(d)(7)).
PUD.minLotNote: "Minimum lot size. No minimum lot size shall be required within a PUD." The minimum TRACT is 8 acres of contiguous land (348,480 sq ft), or 4.5 acres (196,020 sq ft) for a qualifying affordable-housing development.
PUD.note: Planned Unit Development District. Distance between structures: 15 ft between detached single-family buildings, 20 ft between multifamily buildings. Open space at least 35% of the gross area of the PUD. No lot-coverage percentage; FAR limited to the Comprehensive Plan. An applicant may propose alternative development standards, which if approved by the City Commission supersede these. § 16-101.

PDD.frontNote: "Perimeter development requirement. No housing type, use, setback, height, and coverage requirements are established. However, existing residentially zoned property adjacent to the perimeter of the PDD shall be protected by setbacks, landscaping, minimum ten-foot high decorative walls, and other buffers to be established as part of the PDD master plan." (§ 16-109(d)(2)).
PDD.sideNote: "Internal development requirement. a. No minimum lot sizes shall be required. b. No minimum distance between on-site structures shall be required. c. No minimum yard setbacks shall be required." (§ 16-109(d)(3)).
PDD.rearNote: Same clause: no minimum yard setbacks required.
PDD.heightNote: No height requirement is established; see the perimeter clause above.
PDD.minLotNote: No minimum lot sizes. Minimum SITE area is 8 acres of contiguous land (348,480 sq ft).
PDD.note: Planned Development District. The code expressly declines to set setback, height and coverage standards; they are fixed in the PDD master plan. Every dimensional value is null on purpose. § 16-109.
